PART 2 ASBESTOS AND ITS PRODUCTS

0.1 This

FOREWORD

Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 3 August 1987, after the draft finalized by the Cement and had been approved by the Civil Concrete Sectional Committee Engineering Division Council. 0.2 In recent years there has been a growing awareness that exposure to Accorasbestos dust can have harmful effect on the health of workers. dingly, a number of standards giving technical guidance on how the risk of exposure to asbestos dust can be prevented, controlled or miniIt has also been felt necessmized, have been taken up for formulation. ary that some pictorial warning signs and precautionary notices shall be used at workplaces involving asbestos and asbestos products, packages containing asbestos and asbestos products and also on the asbestos products, in order to caution the workers and users about the potential Keeping this in view, this standard regardhealth hazards of asbestos. ing pictorial warning signs and~precautionary notices has been formulated in two parts as follows: a) Recommendations for pictorial warning signs and precautionary notices for asbestos and products containing asbestos: Part Workplaces 1

b) Recommendations for pictorial warning signs and precautionary notices for asbestos and products containing asbestos: Part 2 Asbestos and its products 0.3 In the formulation of this standard, due weightage has been given to international co-ordination among the standards and practices prevailing in different countries, in addition to relating it to the practices in the field in this country. 3

4

IS : 12081( -Part 2 ) - 1987 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard deals with pictorial warning signs and precautionary notices recommended for use with asbestos and products containing asbestos. 2. OBJECT 2.1 The object of this standard is to caution those engaged in handling of asbestos and products containing asbestos so as to enable them to take necessary precautionary measures against the risks from exposure to asbestos dust. 3. LABELLING 3.1 All asbestos packages, products containing asbestos and the packages of such products, excepting those mentioned in 3.2, shall bear a pictorial warning sign and precautionary notice as shown in Fig. 1. 3.2 Labelling of products containing asbestos in accordance with 3.1 may be dispensed with or modified, subject to the conditions given in 3.2.1 to 3.2.3.2. 3.2.1 Labelling on the product may be dispensed-with if smallness of size of the products makes it impossible for the product to be labelled. Such products shall be supplied in a package which shall be duly labelled as given in 3.1. 3.2.2 Labelling of compressed asbestos fibre jointings and beater addition jointings in which asbestos is firmly encapsulated with a strong bonding agent and will not release asbestos dust during normal handling and use, may be dispensed with. 3.2.3 In case of unpacked articles, for example, asbestos cement sheet and pipe where it is not practicable to mark the pictorical warning sign and precautionary notice as given in 3.1, the procedure given in 3.2.3.1 and 3.2.3.2 shall be adopted. the 3.2.3.1 The symbol `a' as portrayed in Fig. 1 ( except precautionary notice ) shall be printed/stamped on the article very conspicuously. 3.2.3.2 Pictorial warning sign and precautionary notice in 3.1 shall be printed on literatures given to a purchaser. as given

3.3 Appropriate safety rules sheet shall be provided along with asbestos and products containing asbestos.
